## Setup

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

cfg <- list(
  daily_dir = file.path("data", "daily"),
  five_min_dir = file.path("data", "5min"),
  tidy_dir = file.path("data", "tidy"),
  analysis_start_date = as.Date("2025-03-01"),
  timezone = "UTC"
)
```

## Scope

Descriptive summaries of the study date window and smartwatch firmware availability.

## Data import

```{r, message=FALSE}
if (!exists("gps_daily", inherits = FALSE)) {
  gps_daily <- read_csv(
    file.path(cfg$daily_dir, "gps_daily.csv.gz"),
    col_types = cols(userId = col_character(), date = col_date(), deviceId = col_character(), firmware = col_character()),
    locale = locale(tz = "UTC"), na = c("", "NA", "NULL"), show_col_types = FALSE
  )
}
```

## Study date window

Study window: `2025-03-01 < date < Sys.Date()` (UTC). Counts outside it describe study exclusions, not ETL errors.

```{r}
table_dates <- bind_rows(
  gps_daily %>% transmute(data_table = "gps_daily", date = date),
  myair_daily %>% transmute(data_table = "myair_daily", date = date),
  smartwatchhigh_daily %>% transmute(data_table = "smartwatchhigh_daily", date = date),
  smartwatchlow_daily %>% transmute(data_table = "smartwatchlow_daily", date = date),
  sleep_tidy %>% transmute(data_table = "sleep_tidy", date = date),
  gps_5min %>% transmute(data_table = "gps_5min", date = as.Date(bucket_5min, tz = cfg$timezone)),
  myair_5min %>% transmute(data_table = "myair_5min", date = as.Date(bucket_5min, tz = cfg$timezone)),
  smartwatchhigh_5min %>% transmute(data_table = "smartwatchhigh_5min", date = as.Date(bucket_5min, tz = cfg$timezone)),
  smartwatchlow_5min %>% transmute(data_table = "smartwatchlow_5min", date = as.Date(bucket_5min, tz = cfg$timezone))
)

date_summary <- table_dates %>%
  group_by(data_table) %>%
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    on_or_before_start = sum(date <= cfg$analysis_start_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    within_window = sum(date > cfg$analysis_start_date & date < Sys.Date(), na.rm = TRUE),
    today_or_later = sum(date >= Sys.Date(), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"
  )

date_summary %>%
  knitr::kable(
    format = "pipe", big.mark = ",",
    col.names = c("Table", "Rows", "On or before start", "Within window", "Today or later"),
    caption = paste0("Study date window: ", cfg$analysis_start_date, " < date < ", Sys.Date())
  )

rm(table_dates)
```

## Smartwatch firmware provenance

Firmware counts use the complete five-minute tables. Literal `N/A` denotes unknown provenance; it is distinct from missing/blank values and causes no exclusion.

```{r}
firmware_summary <- bind_rows(
  smartwatchhigh_5min %>%
    summarise(data_table = "smartwatchhigh_5min", buckets = n(),
              missing_or_blank = sum(is.na(firmware) | trimws(firmware) == ""),
              unknown_code = sum(firmware == "N/A", na.rm = TRUE)),
  smartwatchlow_5min %>%
    summarise(data_table = "smartwatchlow_5min", buckets = n(),
              missing_or_blank = sum(is.na(firmware) | trimws(firmware) == ""),
              unknown_code = sum(firmware == "N/A", na.rm = TRUE))
)

firmware_summary %>%
  knitr::kable(format = "pipe", big.mark = ",",
               col.names = c("Table", "Buckets", "Missing/blank firmware", "Firmware N/A"),
               caption = "Five-minute smartwatch provenance; no rows are removed")
```

Missing aggregate firmware may also indicate multiple firmware versions within a bucket.
